stem: Meena tests four food items in her school science laboratory using iodine solution. She adds a few drops of iodine to each item and notes the colour. Which food item shows the presence of starch?

options.text: A slice of apple, which turns light brown
A piece of boiled potato, which turns blue-black
A spoon of dal, which stays yellow-brown
A drop of mustard oil, which shows no colour change

teacher.key_rationale: The starch test with iodine gives a blue-black colour only when starch is present. Only the boiled potato turns blue-black, so option B is the key. Apple, dal, and oil show no blue-black change, so they are distractors.
